title: Readmission spike versus case mix
prompt: Thirty-day readmission rose from 11% to 15% after a discharge workflow change. Determine the strongest explanation.
facts: The workflow change launched hospital-wide in April.
Readmission had already risen to 13.5% in March.
The share of high-acuity heart-failure discharges rose from 14% to 27% from February to May.
Within each acuity band, readmission stayed within one percentage point of its prior range.
Two units with unchanged case mix received the new workflow but had no material readmission increase.
One source feed omitted severity scores for 9% of May discharges.
